verses.t: I swear by this city, Makkah
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city
verses.yusufAli: I do call to witness this City
verses.rodwell: I NEED not to swear by this SOIL
verses.sale: I swear by this territory

verses.t: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city
verses.pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city
verses.yusufAli: And thou art a freeman of this City
verses.rodwell: This soil on which thou dost dwell
verses.sale: and thou, O prophet, residest in this territory

verses.t: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him]
verses.pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat
verses.yusufAli: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child
verses.rodwell: Or by sire and offspring
verses.sale: and by the begetter, and that which He hath begotten

verses.t: We have certainly created man into hardship
verses.pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere
verses.yusufAli: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle
verses.rodwell: Surely in trouble have we created man
verses.sale: verily We have created man in misery

verses.t: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him
verses.pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him
verses.yusufAli: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him
verses.rodwell: What! thinketh he that no one hath power over him
verses.sale: Doth he think that none shall prevail over him

verses.t: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance
verses.pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth
verses.yusufAli: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance
verses.rodwell: I have wasted," saith he, "enormous riches
verses.sale: He saith, I have wasted plenty of riches

verses.t: Does he think that no one has seen him
verses.pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him
verses.yusufAli: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him
verses.rodwell: What! thinketh he that no one regardeth him
verses.sale: Doth he think that none seeth him

verses.t: Have We not made for him two eyes
verses.pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
verses.yusufAli: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes
verses.rodwell: What! have we not made him eyes
verses.sale: Have we not made him two eyes

verses.t: And a tongue and two lips
verses.pickthall: And a tongue and two lips
verses.yusufAli: And a tongue, and a pair of lips
verses.rodwell: And tongue, and lips
verses.sale: and a tongue, and two lips

verses.t: And have shown him the two ways
verses.pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways
verses.yusufAli: And shown him the two highways
verses.rodwell: And guided him to the two highways
verses.sale: and shewn him the two highways of good and evil

verses.t: But he has not broken through the difficult pass
verses.pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent
verses.yusufAli: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep
verses.rodwell: Yet he attempted not the steep
verses.sale: Yet he attempteth not the cliff

verses.t: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep
verses.rodwell: And who shall teach thee what the steep is
verses.sale: What shall make thee to understand what the cliff is

verses.t: It is the freeing of a slave
verses.pickthall: (It is) to free a slave
verses.yusufAli: (It is:) freeing the bondman
verses.rodwell: It is to ransom the captive
verses.sale: It is to free the captive

verses.t: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
verses.pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger
verses.yusufAli: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
verses.rodwell: Or to feed in the day of famine
verses.sale: or to feed, in the day of famine

verses.t: An orphan of near relationship
verses.pickthall: An orphan near of kin
verses.yusufAli: To the orphan with claims of relationship
verses.rodwell: The orphan who is near of kin
verses.sale: the orphan who is of kin

verses.t: Or a needy person in misery
verses.pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery
verses.yusufAli: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust
verses.rodwell: or the poor that lieth in the dust
verses.sale: or the poor man who lieth on the ground

verses.t: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion
verses.pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity
verses.yusufAli: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion
verses.rodwell: Beside this, to be of those who believe, and enjoin stedfastness on each other, and enjoin compassion on each other
verses.sale: Whoso doth this, and is one of those who believe, and recommend perseverance unto each other, and recommend mercy unto each other

verses.t: Those are the companions of the right
verses.pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand
verses.yusufAli: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand
verses.rodwell: These shall be the people of the right hand
verses.sale: these shall be the companions of the right-hand

verses.t: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left
verses.pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand
verses.yusufAli: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand
verses.rodwell: While they who disbelieve our signs, Shall be the people of the left
verses.sale: But they who shall disbelieve our signs, shall be the companions of the left-hand

verses.t: Over them will be fire closed in
verses.pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them
verses.yusufAli: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round)
verses.rodwell: Around them the fire shall close
verses.sale: Above them shall be arched fire
